fan_rule: Each SDK indexed polygon is triangulated from its first index; never fit, reorder or repair vertices or planes.
measurements: Oriented edge closure, degeneracy, normalized fan convexity and own-polygon nonplanarity
Signed fan volume versus SciPy ConvexHull(returned vertices) volume; raw normalized SDK halfspace residuals
27 frozen bore witnesses: original STL winding and surface distance; raw SDK halfspaces, vertex hulls, indexed winding only if closed, nondegenerate and convex within existing epsilon
scope: All representations are descriptive candidates, not actual collider replacements. No clouds, CAD union resampling, cooking, Kit, simulation, altered gates or right-tip inference.
outcome: Always proceed_gate_passed=false; R3 remains failed. No D/R or recook authorized.

numerical_reporting_constants.interpretation: Numerical reporting/unknown classification only, not physical fidelity acceptance tolerances.

candidate_membership_interpretation: For raw SDK halfspaces and vertex hulls, max-plane residual in [-epsilon,+epsilon] is UNKNOWN; a union is inside if any candidate is strictly inside, outside only if every candidate is strictly outside. Indexed winding is UNKNOWN for invalid topology/convexity or surface distance <=epsilon. This descriptive boundary band does not modify the closed-solid R3 acceptance rule.
